text.zh-CN: 分解初速度并用水平、竖直运动预测抛体轨迹。
text.en: Resolve initial velocity and combine horizontal and vertical motion to predict a projectile trajectory.

prerequisites.zh-CN: 了解速度、加速度与三角函数。
prerequisites.en: Understands velocity, acceleration, and trigonometric ratios.

text.zh-CN: 误以为无空气阻力时水平速度也会不断减小。
text.en: Assuming horizontal velocity decreases without air resistance.

text.zh-CN: 误以为任何任务的最佳发射角都必然是 45°。
text.en: Assuming every launch task must have an optimal angle of 45°.

fallback.zh-CN: 若动画不可用，请用 x=v₀cosθ·t 与 y=v₀sinθ·t-½gt² 计算。
fallback.en: If animation is unavailable, calculate with x=v₀cosθ·t and y=v₀sinθ·t-½gt².

prompt.zh-CN: 在同高发射和落地、速度不变时，射程在哪个角度附近最大？
prompt.en: For equal launch and landing heights at fixed speed, near which angle is range greatest?
